premises.text: Meaningful health metrics for users and loved ones are hard to capture today
premises.evidence_span: But how much do you really know about measurements that truly matter?

premises.text: Nine-sensor Dyno captures many health metrics including cuffless BP in 60 seconds and syncs to mobile or cradle
premises.evidence_span: It's nine integrated sensors and analytics. It's able to track 33 different health metrics

premises.text: Aging-care and other care settings benefit when analytics flag abnormalities early
premises.evidence_span: Having the ability to track their health has dramatic implication on the quality of the care they're going to receive

premises.text: States/Medicare remote monitoring and hospital readmission pressure expand paid use cases
premises.evidence_span: There are now 17 states that pay for remote monitoring. And the Medicare is about to join the party as well

premises.text: Revenue from subscriptions, OEM/licensing, and later data mining
premises.evidence_span: How do we make money? Through subscription base, OEM and licensing revenue

value.text: Empower users and care organizations with rapid health metrics for preventive action
value.evidence_span: empowering you to take control of your health

secondary_value.text: Improve quality of care for the growing aging population
secondary_value.evidence_span: dramatic implication on the quality of the care they're going to receive
